sections.heading: PRDA.JK — Prodia Widyahusada
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** re-tested against new evidence, not price: #1 INDO NEGLECTED / #2 MOMENTUM at IDR 3,620 (10 below the 10-29 mark), and the 29-Oct 9M-26 disclosure (profit +10% y/y on 15m tests — the first volume print after four flat-revenue years, FY22-25 IDR 2.18-2.28trn). The print is the delta.

**Regime:** NEUTRAL — no tilt covers ID diagnostics; IDR-domestic, net cash (IDR 568bn), non-rate-sensitive, defensive under CAUTIOUS.

**Archetype:** `neglected_midcap_discovery` (0.44/+55/−30, 2.5y) · method card VAL_DIVIDEND_ANCHOR (78% payout, ~5.0% yield on FY25 DPS IDR 182, 1.7x FCF cover).

**3 questions a deep-dive must answer:** (1) Is the 9M inflection volume-led and durable — Q2-26 alone was NI −3.8% y/y (IDR 60.3 vs 62.7bn) on revenue +12.7%? (2) Why did EBIT margin fall 13.8% (FY23) → 10.0% (FY25) on flat revenue — structural panel pricing, or fixed-cost deleverage that 15m tests re-lever? (3) What discovery catalyst re-rates this, and is the payout safe while capex runs IDR 145-245bn/yr?

**Fast-disqualify:**
- EV at registry base: +7.4%/2.5y (~2.9%/yr) — positive but far under the hurdle.
- Valuation anchor FAILS the up-leg: +55% = IDR 5,611 = **~22x FY26E EPS (~250)** or ~19x FY28E; an 8.6%-ROE, four-year flat-revenue business does not support it, and the ~15.9x trailing is already paid on an EPS base 18% below FY23.
- Primary sources: ✓ 9M-26 LK, FY25 AR, IDX disclosures.

DISCARD. Re-advance only on margin/ROE re-lever evidence (two quarters of EBIT margin ≥12% with revenue growth), never on price.
